function.name: run_sql
function.arguments: {"sql":"SELECT period, account_code, SUM(amount_cad) AS account_total FROM lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.gl_balance WHERE account_type='opex' AND period IN ('2026-08','2026-09') GROUP BY period, account_code ORDER BY period, account_code","purpose":"Check OPEX accounts totals for Aug and Sep 2026"}
